messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

Molti son li animali a cui s'ammoglia, Many are the animals with which she wives,
e più saranno ancora, infin che ’l veltro and there shall be more yet, till the hound
verrà, che la farà morir con doglia. shall come, that will make her die of grief.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Telugu translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (sense) | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Molti | Quantifier “many” | అనేక | many | OK | | son | Copular verb “are” (present) | — (copula omitted) | are | UNNECESSARY (Telugu often drops “to be”) | | li | Definite article, plural | — | the | UNNECESSARY | | animali | Noun “animals” | జంతువులు | animals | OK | | a | Preposition “with” (introducing relative clause) | — | with | UNNECESSARY | | cui | Relative pronoun “which / whom” | — | which | UNNECESSARY | | s'ammoglia | Verb “wives / takes as spouse” (reflexive) | వివాహం చేసుకునే | (she) weds / takes as spouse | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | మరియు | and | OK | | più | Comparative adverb “more” | ఇంకా ఎక్కువ | more / still more | OK | | saranno | Future copula “shall be” | ఉంటాయి | will be | OK | | ancora | Temporal adverb “still / yet” | ఇంకా | still / yet | OK | | infin | Subordinating conjunction “till / until” | వచ్చేవరకు | until (the hound comes) | OK | | che | Relative/conjunctive “that” (introducing result clause) | — | that | UNNECESSARY | | ’l | Definite article “the” (elided *il*) | — | the | UNNECESSARY | | veltro | Noun “hound” | వేటగాడు | hound | OK | | verrà | Future verb “shall come” | వస్తాడు | will come | OK | | la | Object pronoun “her” | ఆమెను | her (object) | OK | | farà | Causative verb “will make” | మరణింపజేస్తాడు (part of phrase) | will cause to die | OK | | morir | Infinitive “die” | (combined in “మరణింపజేస్తాడు”) | die | OK | | con | Preposition “of” (in “die of grief”) | తో | with / of | OK | | doglia | Noun “grief” | దుఃఖం | grief | OK |
---
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *son, li, a, cui, che, ’l* – these function words are not required in Telugu and were omitted or absorbed by case/agreement morphology. - **OK**: All content‑bearing words (nouns, verbs, adverbs, quantifiers) are rendered appropriately.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected in the Telugu rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 1** - Original: అనేక జంతువులు ఆమె వివాహం చేసుకునేవి, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 2** - Original: మరియు ఇంకా ఎక్కువ జంతువులు ఉంటాయి, వేటగాడు వచ్చే వరకు - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 3** - Original: వేటగాడు వస్తాడు, అది ఆమెను దుఃఖంతో మరణింపజేస్తుంది. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` అనేక జంతువులు ఆమె వివాహం చేసుకునేవి, మరియు ఇంకా ఎక్కువ జంతువులు ఉంటాయి, వేటగాడు వచ్చే వరకు వేటగాడు వస్తాడు, అది ఆమెను దుఃఖంతో మరణింపజేస్తుంది. ```
